DATUM LIBRARY STANDARDS RECONCILIATION
Noncanonical read-only review transport; 2026-10-09

Authority and limits
Consolidates the six standards reconciliation messages sent to the appointed
manager. Authorized work is research and this temporary artifact only. No
implementation, canonical documentation, source adoption, imports, compliance
PASS, or new product defaults are authorized. Line references identify the
workspace inspected for this audit; they are not immutable revision pins.
Owning evidence routes were inspected and relevant sources/consumers reviewed;
this is a bounded audit, not a claim that every research route was requalified.
Public previews do not supply every normative clause or licensed table.

1. Rule and provenance hierarchy

Authorized product/profile decisions determine applicable scope. Within that
scope, distinguish these authorities rather than treating every number as IPC:
- Exact standard edition, profile and clause: applicable requirements and
  recommendations, with their original normative/informative force preserved.
- Exact manufacturer drawing/datasheet revision and pages: device-specific
  terminal/pin identity, dimensions/tolerances and recommended land patterns.
- Fabricator/assembler process evidence: registration, minimum mask webs,
  assembly process, stencil thickness, aperture release and acceptable geometry.
- Datum house style: presentation and authoring conventions; these cannot
  silently replace imported geometry or manufacturer facts.
- Unknown or inferred basis: explicit uncertainty, not a compliance assertion.
This is a provenance hierarchy, not an automatic conflict override. Conflicting
requirements need a recorded basis decision or reviewed deviation.

Owning contracts:
specs/STANDARDS_COMPLIANCE_SPEC.md:43-68 defines support dispositions and excludes
certification implications; :183 keeps symbol-style policy Planned; :488-495
keeps land-pattern, stencil/paste and related families Planned or Reference-only;
:499-513 requires style profiles/custom identification.
docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_010_INDUSTRY_STANDARDS_COMPLIANCE.md:74-83
requires basis/validation/deviation/unknown visibility; :103-107 requires
canonical proposal-first corrections; :123-127 prohibits silent AI basis
selection; :183-214 describes basis kind/revision/profile/provenance; :352-368
limits claims and requires report uncertainty and check-version context.
Do not infer that a stored basis string establishes algorithmic support.

2. Symbol body, pin dimensions and rendering

IEC's public application guidance makes shape/content meaningful, permits
different sizes, and uses a grid modulus to preserve proportions/readability.
The modulus is at least lettering height. This audit establishes no universal
symbol-body dimensions or pin-stub length in nanometres.
Primary source: IEC 60617 public preview, printed PDF page 7, Symbol size and
Representation of terminals (web extracted lines 355-392):
https://webstore.iec.ch/en/iec_catalog/product/preview/?id=L3B1Yi9wZGYvcHJldmlldy9pbmZvX2llYzYwNjE3e2VkMS4wfWIucGRm

docs/gui/DATUM_RENDERING_BOOK.md:58-77 governs filled bodies, optical corners,
short stubs, connection dots, labels and stroke hierarchy. :239-243 locks the
canonical authored/generated IEC rectangular preference. These are Datum
presentation choices; optical view radius is not manufactured geometry or an
IEC absolute-dimension table. Manufacturer package pitch is not symbol pitch.
Imported symbols retain source geometry and explicit imported/custom status;
repairs require a reviewed proposal, source lineage and before/after evidence.

Implemented: crates/engine/src/pool/symbol.rs:9-28 stores style assertions,
standards basis, check state, provenance, drawings and pin anchors; :75-118
stores optional pin orientation/length/decoration.
Missing/not established: semantic IEC shape/proportion conformity validation,
verified standard-specific body/stub numeric rules, and complete standards-aware
native-authoring/port qualification. Metadata storage is not such validation.

3. Copper lands, solder mask and paste

Copper lands require more than body size: terminal dimensions/spans/tolerances,
solder-joint goals, fabrication/placement tolerances, pitch, assembly process,
clearance/courtyard and package-specific conditions. Mask depends on NSMD/SMD
choice, registration and minimum web constraints. Paste depends on aperture
geometry/area, stencil thickness/release and assembly recommendations.
No universal positive mask expansion or negative paste reduction was established.
Equal-size paste and copper must not be declared universally invalid from these
sources alone; neither should arbitrary equal-size apertures be deemed qualified.

Primary source: IPC-7352 public preview, May 2023, printed page 1, section 1
Scope and notes (web extracted lines 188-219): process/company adjustments may
be needed; use specific manufacturer dimensions and consider mask registration,
stencil apertures and mounting conditions.
https://www.ipc.org/TOC/IPC-7352-TOC.pdf
Its contents identifies component/land tolerancing and thermal-tab paste topics,
but this preview does not provide all numeric rules or stencil tables.

docs/IPC_FOOTPRINT_SYSTEM.md:10-14 identifies the current chip/SOIC slice;
:60-82 requires source dimensions/tolerances and relevant process basis;
:84-100 defines intentional deviations; :217-249 requires source preservation
and shows illustrative +5 mil mask/-5 mil paste values. Those examples are not
a universal standard clause. :338-363 retains broader audit/deviation workflows.
docs/gui/DATUM_RENDERING_BOOK.md:247-259 specifies rounded copper geometry and
fab-dependent silk clearance. Rounded copper is actual geometry, not an optical
rendering substitute; an unsupported imported rounded pad cannot silently become
a rectangle. Approximate silk values are not an edition/clause qualification.

4. Implemented recipe checks versus missing qualification

crates/engine/src/pool/ipc_footprint.rs:14-17 labels current derivations IPC-7351B;
:36-81 hardcodes density/J/courtyard values; :85-117 records nominal source
dimensions and basis; :122-154 takes chip/SOIC geometry and caller offsets.
:200-201 and :344-345 apply explicit mask expansion and negative paste reduction;
:425-429 and :462-467 reject negative input but permit zero.
Implemented: chip and SOIC rectangular copper generation, selected recipe basis,
caller-specified mask/paste offsets and density-derived courtyard.
Missing/not established: full min/max component/fabrication/placement tolerance
analysis, verified normative provenance of every hardcoded J value, broader
package families, and manufacturer-specific qualification.

crates/engine/src/pool/library_graph_diagnostics_ipc.rs:14-20 returns immediately
for absent/null ipc_basis; :22-56 decodes/checks basis and naming consistency;
:57-63 selects only IPC-7351B chip/SOIC geometry validators; :65-227 checks basis
shape and chip derived rectangle/policy equality; :228-317 covers SOIC.
Implemented: schema and selected recipe consistency checks.
Missing/not established: an unconditional unknown-basis finding from this
validator, full normative standard checking, or detection of a structurally
valid but manufacturer-wrong pin/pad mapping. Matching a recipe is not certification.

crates/engine/src/pool/padstack.rs:50-53 supports Circle/Rect copper only;
:69-85 provides inherited/exposed/tented/expansion mask and
inherited/none/aperture/expansion paste policies.
Missing in this schema: rounded copper and arbitrary separate/segmented paste
apertures. No claim is made that every other board representation lacks those
features. The prior starter rounded-pad representation blocker remains.

5. Active board DRC and policy mismatch

crates/engine/src/drc/mod.rs:67 calls process aperture checking.
crates/engine/src/drc/checks/mod.rs:352-439 implements active checks:
- Zero-offset exposed mask/paste is treated as inherited from copper.
- Board setup mask/paste offsets are enforced.
- :446-498 compares pad policies against the peer majority within a footprint.
- :503-525 emits findings with basis datum.process_aperture_and_geometry.current,
  revision v1, not a verified IPC clause.
crates/engine/src/drc/tests/mod_tests_dimensions_and_silk.rs:184-185 uses
127000nm process offsets; :230 asserts inherited-aperture behavior; :256-300
tests peer-policy inconsistency. Tests establish behavior, not standards correctness.

Manager captured incidental defect as dat-aperture-process-basis-ttr9 and
flushed tracker. These checks can
reject intentional 1:1 paste/zero-clearance apertures and legitimate differing
thermal/signal pad policies. Explicit 1:1 cannot be distinguished from inheritance
by the zero-offset test. Generator zero-offset allowance and DRC rejection are
inconsistent. A selected manufacturing basis must decide applicability and
exceptions. No repair, new rule, blanket waiver or acceptance is authorized.
This is not evidence that process checking is entirely absent.

6. Starter qualification and research discrepancies

Native-authored and ported content need the same evidence basis. For each
Symbol/Package/Footprint/Padstack retain:
- Original geometry, source revision/hash and transformation lineage.
- Selected standard profile, edition and exact applicable clause/table evidence.
- Exact manufacturer drawing revision/pages, dimensions/tolerances and pin/pad
  mapping proof, including polarity/orientation and body/terminal distinctions.
- Copper derivation and mask/stencil process sources and assumptions.
- Supported check scope/results and unknowns/deviations/explicit repair review.
Import alone supplies no compliance PASS. Do not silently normalize source
geometry or refresh protected visual evidence to bless a lane violation.

Research discrepancy correction: the earlier six-message transport incorrectly
described a research claim as Rev A January 2024. The actual local text is Rev A
July 2023, at research/ipc-compliance/IPC_COMPLIANCE_RESEARCH.md:20-21 and :217-219.
The May 2023 IPC public preview does not establish that claimed later revision;
exact selected edition requires primary verification before use. This artifact
corrects the transport without changing the source research.
The same research :259 says paste is almost never the copper size; :266-292
discusses 0.66 area ratio and 1.5 aspect ratio recommendations. This audit does
not promote them to universally mandatory clauses or implemented validators.

not override exact source rights review. Prior starter license evidence remains
applicable: KiCad's license describes CC-BY-SA 4.0 and its design exception;
modified library redistribution remains subject to applicable obligations.
https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/
No generic clean-redraw permission or blanket redistribution prohibition is

conversion.content:
DATUM LIBRARY CONVERSION WORKFLOW PROPOSAL
Noncanonical planning transport; 2026-10-09

Direction, not execution authority
Provide a first-party conversion pipeline that extracts a selected source graph,
produces inspectable typed candidates, preserves supported data, reports losses,
and publishes accepted native objects through the canonical journal. Conversion
fidelity, manufacturer correctness and standards qualification are separate
results. No imports, adoption, production changes or canonical spec edits were
performed or authorized by this proposal. Existing import-freeze/native-first,
license authority, ownership and independent review requirements remain.

Inputs reused unchanged
/tmp/datum-starter-packet-01.txt
SHA256 5c16fcb1453afb32600a64ba36198164f30528cca78da7e9c287ffe55916311e
/tmp/datum-library-standards-reconciliation.txt
SHA256 04d398bf39d704d2916aa19d7193637570ee89c93abd3c8de3e8c44fb5d13420

1. Source adapters and complete extraction
Adapters parse Horizon JSON, KiCad library files or Eagle XML into one bounded
candidate format. Start with one Horizon subset; adding formats is subsequent
scope, not a prerequisite or permission to run current import APIs.
An extraction manifest selects roots, exact repository revision/file hashes,
source format version, license/attribution, selected Symbols and asset policy.
Walk the complete reachable graph: base Parts, Entity gates, Units/pins,
explicitly selected Symbols, Package, pads/Padstacks, parameter inputs/programs
and declared assets. Detect cycles, duplicate/conflicting identities, missing
references, incompatible types and ambiguous inheritance before conversion.
Horizon Entity-to-Unit links do not select a Symbol; make this choice explicit.
Compute and display the full closure, not merely a list of root files.
Separate required functional closure from optional assets. Excluding 3D models
must be explicit and remove unusable target references while retaining source
references in the report. Do not claim full asset fidelity for that result.
Retain source bytes where permitted, exact digests, license notices, source
links and lineage through inheritance. Do not copy external application code.

2. Typed intermediate candidates
Proposed intermediate records contain source identities/locations, typed edges,
effective attributes plus inheritance origins, symbols/pins, body/terminals,
land patterns/Padstacks/process apertures, graphics/layers and optional assets.
Every transformed field carries its source and conversion rule/version.
Use exact source numeric representation until a documented native conversion;
record original unit, integer nanometre conversion, precision/rounding limits,
axis/rotation/mirror conventions and error/refusal on overflow or ambiguity.
No coordinate snapping, pin renumbering, layer guessing, corner flattening or
mask/paste normalization hidden inside the adapter.
Parameter programs require a reviewed bounded evaluator of selected operations,
or an independently evidenced resolved value. Preserve parameter inputs and
derivation. Never execute arbitrary upstream programs or silently omit them.
Do not add speculative general-purpose IR to every engine subsystem: this is
an inspectable conversion boundary, with exact schema still subject to review.

3. Native object mapping
Horizon Unit -> Datum Unit and stable logical Pins.
Selected Horizon Symbol -> Datum Symbol drawings/anchors/style and Unit link.
Horizon Entity/gates -> Datum Entity/Gates with explicit Unit/Symbol choices.
Horizon Package -> separate Datum Package body/terminal facts and Footprint
  lands/courtyard/silk/fab/assembly/mechanical/process information.
Horizon Padstack -> Datum Padstack only where exact geometry/policies supported.
Horizon Part effective attributes -> Datum Part with manufacturer/MPN/value,
  data lineage and default Footprint/PinPadMap links.
Source pad-to-gate/pin connection -> explicit Datum PinPadMap; retain original
  pad identity/name, gate/pin UUIDs and exact mapping correspondence.
Source UUIDs live in a namespaced ImportMap, not an unqualified global identity.
Reuse canonical import allocation where appropriate; preserve identities on
reconversion only after continuity and split/merge/replacement review. A root
hash change must not silently remap placed components.
Source footprint geometry does not prove manufacturer body/terminal dimensions.
Missing native facts remain unknown, or require a separately attributed,
reviewed manufacturer augmentation. Never infer a qualified body from pads.
Native filenames/layout follow current resolver authority; proposed .dat_*
suffixes are not adopted by this proposal.

4. Conversion report, standards audit and corrections
Report every source feature as exact-supported, transformed with stated error,
unsupported, excluded by declared scope, or unknown. Attach source location,
affected target IDs, reason and required remedy. Required geometry/mapping
losses block publication; retaining raw source text alone is not native support.
Rounded copper, arbitrary paste apertures and unresolved parameter operations
must not become rectangles/defaults. Unknown manufacturer evidence stays unknown.
Review conversion fidelity first. Independently assess pin/pad/polarity facts and
selected standards/process basis, with exact editions and evidence. Native
creation and conversion share these qualification rules; do not label conversion
success IPC/IEC compliant. Retain dat-aperture-process-basis-ttr9 findings.
If a correction is needed, show original versus proposed geometry/mapping,
reason, evidence and affected objects. Apply accepted corrections as explicit
canonical proposals with lineage; do not rewrite the original extraction.

5. Atomic canonical publication
Capture target model/journal basis, identity map and existing object revisions.
Validate the entire proposed final graph, including references, unique identity,
pin/pad correspondence and supported feature closure. Existing per-object typed
checks are insufficient. Reject stale target/source basis and conflicting IDs.
After authorized review, one canonical OperationBatch publishes the accepted
objects plus required ImportMap/provenance metadata through existing library
operations. Use journal conflict/recovery and inverse-operation mechanisms;
do not directly write pool files or merge only an in-memory Pool.
If required provenance cannot fit current schema, first design its explicit
canonical mechanism; a temporary report is not a durable substitute.
Capture exact accepted revision/digest closure. Retained whole-graph history and
safe placed-component updates remain separate delivery gaps; no latest-wins
update or silent replacement of existing placements.
Derived search/index publication follows accepted canonical commit; invalidate
stale projection and rebuild transactionally or through staged publication.
Index failure must not leave partial canonical source or conceal graph failure.

6. Reusable code and missing mechanisms
Reusable, subject to exact current contracts:
- crates/engine/src/import/kicad/footprint.rs:14-104 provides a parsed native
  Package/Footprint/Padstack candidate, source hash and ImportMap allocation.
  :49-85 leaves body/terminals and fab/assembly empty; not a complete Part.
- crates/engine/src/import/eagle/pool_builder.rs:12 onward constructs linked
  pool records/PinPadMap; :70-71 emits empty Symbol drawings/anchors.
  pool_builder_landpattern.rs:8-48 leaves body terminals/fab/assembly empty.
- crates/engine/src/substrate/import_map.rs:15-67 provides identity/status
  records and deterministic allocation; import_map_journal_ops.rs provides
  canonical map mutation. Exact source namespace/continuity policy still needed.
- crates/engine/src/substrate/pool_journal_ops.rs:12-122 stages/applies library
  operations, :243 provides inverse operations, :389-486 validates typed objects.
- crates/engine/src/pool/library_graph.rs:100-172 registers/validates linked
  objects; reuse diagnostics and add required final-batch admission integration.
- crates/engine/src/substrate/journal.rs and proposal_journal_ops.rs provide
  canonical batch/proposal staging; existing component binding and PM057 frozen
  pad materialization are downstream reuse seams, not conversion acceptance.
Bypass to avoid: crates/engine/src/api/project_surface.rs:181-200 performs legacy
in-memory imports; KiCad path omits the returned Footprint. It is not publication.
Missing: Horizon adapter, complete typed extraction/parameter interpretation,
faithful symbol/land/process mapping, feature coverage diagnostics, durable
provenance/closure receipt, final-graph admission and review-to-publication flow.
Current pool Padstack Circle/Rect schema limits exact rounded/paste conversion;
standards support and process DRC limitations are in the reconciliation artifact.
Use existing dependencies; new third-party code requires exact prior PM029
owner/license authority. No dependency or broad parser rewrite is presumed.

7. Smallest concrete end-to-end slice after a future exact grant
Propose one Horizon LM321MF Part and its complete selected functional graph at
commit 0696685973dee6c9d7202704d23510768e212744:
parts/ic/opamp/LM321_by_TI.json, including its base, Entity, amplifier and power
Units, explicitly selected amplifier/power Symbols, SOT-23-5 Package and required
Padstack/parameter dependencies. Expand exact closure from the starter manifest;
do not assume this shorthand lists every dependency.
Why: it exercises inheritance, multiple gates, explicit power pins, logical-to-
physical mapping and rectangular pads without depending on rounded 0603 support.
Manufacturer reference: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm321.pdf
Packet records SNOS935C Rev C, page 3: 1 +IN, 2 V-/GND, 3 -IN, 4 OUT, 5 V+/VCC.
This is mapping evidence, not complete package/process qualification.
Exclude 3D only as a declared optional asset boundary. Evaluate every required
selected parameter operation exactly or stop with diagnostics. Preserve all
supported graphics/pin/pad/process data; unsupported required data blocks.
Acceptance after grant: inspect extraction/mapping report; review candidate in
ordinary library UI; publish one native graph; browse/place/wire its signal and
power gates; materialize matching PCB pads; save/reopen and undo/redo; compare
source/native geometry, all IDs/mappings and accepted revision/hash closure.
Demonstrate missing dependency, unsupported shape/program, duplicate identity,
stale proposal and interrupted publication refusal without partial native graph.
Measure conversion fidelity separately from ERC/DRC/manufacturing results;
known zero-offset DRC conflict is reported, not repaired by silent pad changes.
This single-Part slice does not waive the six-Part starter workload, safe-update
delivery, native authoring, standards qualification or required independent review.

8. Dimensional qualification for seed evaluation

Owner evidence: dimensional correctness is critical to Datum; the owner has
encountered bundled KiCad models whose mask/paste inherits copper. Treat this
as a per-model seed-evaluation requirement, not a finding about every KiCad
model. KiCad is also an interchange format: a provider's KiCad export is a
different source from the bundled KiCad library. Neither format nor provider
verification establishes qualification of a selected model.

For each candidate, require an inspectable evidence record:
- Identity: exact manufacturer, orderable MPN/package variant and manufacturer
  drawing identifier/revision/pages, including applicable land-pattern/process
  guidance. Resolve suffix/variant and top-versus-bottom-view ambiguity.
- Critical dimensions: body envelope/height, terminal size/span/pitch/location,
  lead or hole geometry and tolerance limits as applicable. Record units and
  min/nominal/max or other stated tolerancing convention. Identify missing facts
  and reconcile conflicting drawings; do not derive body facts from pad size.
- Connectivity: independently compare each logical pin, physical terminal and
  native pad, including pin 1, polarity, orientation, rotations/mirrors, gates,
  exposed pads and intentional multiple-terminal connections. Structural UUID
  validity alone cannot establish manufacturer-correct mapping.
- Copper derivation: preserve source land geometry and document manufacturer
  recommendation or exact selected standard/process calculation, including
  relevant terminal, fabrication and placement assumptions. Record deviations.
- Mask/paste: resolve whether each aperture is explicit, inherited, suppressed,
  generated or unknown; retain footprint/board/process overrides. Require a
  traceable fabricator/assembly/stencil basis for effective shape and dimensions.
  Do not qualify an unexamined inherited aperture merely because it matches
  copper, or reject an intentionally evidenced 1:1 aperture universally. No
  universal expansion/reduction amount is established.
- Conversion precision: compare independently decoded source geometry against
  the native candidate, accounting for units, angle conventions, transforms,
  arc endpoints, corner shape and effective process apertures. Report maximum
  and per-feature conversion differences separately from manufacturing limits;
  preserve exact values where representable. Any required rounding/error limit
  needs an applicable reviewed basis, not a newly invented universal threshold.
- Persistence: native serialization/reload and materialization must preserve
  identities and supported geometry within the recorded precision basis. A
  source-format roundtrip, if separately supported, checks retained source
  semantics; native save/reopen alone is not proof of source equivalence.
- Independent engineering review: verify the critical dimensional/mapping/process
  evidence and proposed deviations using the original manufacturer material,
  not solely the converter's own generated expectations or provider badge.

Separate the resulting evidence states:
Conversion fidelity establishes which supported source facts survived; it can
faithfully preserve incorrect or unqualified source data. Geometry/process
qualification establishes a selected variant and manufacturing basis with
reviewed dimensions/mapping/apertures. Physical assembly evidence, when required
by the product/qualification contract, records the actual fabrication/assembly
process, inspection/fit results and their limits; it cannot be inferred from
either parser success or geometric checks. No zero-error or provider guarantee
is claimed. Unresolved critical dimensions, mapping, unsupported required shapes
or process basis block qualified status. That does not silently decide the
separate owner policy for storing/browsing/placing unqualified candidates.

Existing standards gaps and dat-aperture-process-basis-ttr9 remain visible.
Proposed qualification fields/checks above are not claims that current Datum
implements them, and this amendment supplies no new numeric threshold, source
adoption, implementation or physical qualification authority.
Sources: /tmp/datum-library-standards-reconciliation.txt;
/tmp/datum-library-provider-comparison.txt (SHA256
26a118733e02f95a06cab7f3bde5bc47febb0b948163b6c79f4550bcbc3d1d83);
docs/IPC_FOOTPRINT_SYSTEM.md:60-100,217-249;
docs/decisions/PRODUCT_MECHANICS_010_INDUSTRY_STANDARDS_COMPLIANCE.md:183-214,352-368;
crates/engine/src/pool/ipc_footprint.rs:85-117;
crates/engine/src/drc/checks/mod.rs:352-525. Relevant primary manufacturer and
standards URLs are retained in the preceding sections and referenced artifacts.

9. Decisions needed before implementation/adoption
Exact source subset and license obligations; initial one-Part scope; parameter
operation/feature coverage; required versus optional assets; durable provenance
and identity namespace; unknown-basis publication/placement policy; any new
representation needed to avoid losses. Existing grant and synchronized ownership
must authorize implementation, while source adoption remains separately explicit.
No implementation grant is inferred from this request for direction.

providers.content:
DATUM LIBRARY SOURCE COMPARISON: SNAPEDA / ULTRA LIBRARIAN
Noncanonical read-only research transport; 2026-10-09

Recommendation
Include both providers as potential sources of manufacturer-specific candidate
models. Reuse Ultra Librarian's documented engineering baseline rather than
recreating its datasheet qualification for every part. Prefer KiCad exports for
an eventual user-local conversion route,
because that route is closest to existing Datum parser seams. Do not select a
provider wholesale, declare its models IEC-conforming, or assume that a free
download permits a redistributed Datum starter library or built-in integration.
Automate numerical geometry, mapping and effective-aperture fidelity checks;
route actual evidence gaps or conversion exceptions to engineering review.
Keep the owner out of individual-part review. Source/license authority and native
publication gaps remain separate; no standards defaults are changed here.
This comparison changes no approved source subset or implementation grant.

1. Provider offerings and what was actually established

SnapEDA is currently presented as SnapMagic Search. The owner's OrCAD landing
page advertises symbols, footprints and 3D models and describes an engineering
verification process. Its standards page is more specific: IPC-7351B nominal
footprints and IEEE-315 plus internal symbol conventions; manufacturer-uploaded
models can instead use manufacturer land recommendations. The checker covers
common problems and the provider asks users to verify dimensions for their
application. Record the exact uploader and model status; a general verified
claim is not proof of the particular file's pin mapping or process suitability.
Sources: https://www.snapeda.com/orcad/ (standards section)
https://www.snapeda.com/standards/ (introduction and sections 1-3)
Its KiCad page and import guide also offer a route without OrCAD:
https://www.snapeda.com/kicad/
https://api.snapeda.com/about/import/ (KiCad sections)
The guide identifies modern .kicad_sym/.kicad_mod and legacy .lib/.mod exports.
